lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Answer me.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: How did you find me?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Answer me!

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I thought you would be here.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: You always said that someday, when this was all over,

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: you'd want to spend your days in a place where the cloudless sky meets the horizon.
Cinderella looks out the window.
Outside, the cloudless sky and the horizon intermingle.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: After you ran away, I looked for a place that matched that description.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I assumed that you would have thought that everything was over.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: There were a few places that fit the bill, but this one was the furthest.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: So I figured that's where I'd find you.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Did... Did I say that?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: You did.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I don't remember.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I do.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Why are you here?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: To take you away.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Where?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Anywhere but here.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Wherever it is, I'm not going.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I will stay here.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: And do what? Die?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: ... Yes.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I can't allow that.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I don't need your permission.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: *Sigh*...

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: That's where you're wrong.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I created you, so I get to say when you die.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Come on. Get up.
Abe takes Cinderella's hand,
and she flinches.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I told you to get up.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: What are you trying to do?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Get up so we can have some snacks and chat.
Abe tugs at Cinderella, but she doesn't budge.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Come on. Please.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Forget about me.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I said forget about me.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I've become a monster.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I'm no longer beautiful.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I stood in the Goddess's way. I killed many humans, and my own comrade.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I've ruined everything.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: There's no reason for me to live.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: You have to live.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Why?
Abe sits down in front of Cinderella.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Because I want to be the best engineer this world has ever known.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: You are my creation.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: My greatest masterpiece.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: It can't end like this.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I can't let you end it all on such a miserable note.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Otherwise, I would have created something which didn't amount to anything.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: No, this isn't where the story ends.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Your story can only come to a close when you're at your most beautiful.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I already have too much blood on my hands.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I'm not beautiful anymore.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: My story has been tainted.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: There's no happy ending for me anymore.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: A fairy tale which is no longer beautiful... should be erased.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I've always been watching you.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I didn't want to miss a single moment.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Your perseverance towards achieving your goals.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Your refusal to give up.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Your way of thinking.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: The future. Your dreams.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I watched it all.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I couldn't believe it.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I couldn't believe I could create a masterpiece such as yourself.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I couldn't take my eyes off you.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: You were so beautiful.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: You always had a captive audience in me.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Your attention was focused on the Goddess Squad. You wanted to be part of them.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: To be honest, I wasn't terribly interested in them.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Because you were more beautiful.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: You were shining bright like a diamond, and you were right in front of me, so why would I look at inferior beings that were far away?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: You were the most beautiful being that I ever created.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: My Goddess of Victory.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Goddess of Victory...

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: That's why it can't end here.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: My Goddess of Victory must shine the brightest.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: And be the most beautiful.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Let's rewrite it.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Let's rewrite this fairy tale which has gone astray.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: You're still alive.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: It's not over yet.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: There's still a chance to rewrite this story as many times as we want.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: It's only the first chapter that's finished. There's still a long way to go until the ending.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: There's bound to be plenty of twists and turns along the way.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Let's create a happy ending.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: But... I've already killed so many people.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: You weren't you.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I stood in the way of the Goddess Squad.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: That's not what you intended.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I became the enemy of the entire human race.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: It's not your fault.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I even killed Red Shoes with my own hands.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: You must have had a good reason for what you did.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I trust you.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: No matter what happens, I will always trust you.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I'm blinded by your light and your beauty.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Abe...

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Look. Cinderella.
Abe and Cinderella look at Glass Slippers.
Their reflection is stained with blood.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: What do you see?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: A monster covered in blood.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Don't be a fool.
*Swipe*

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: That can be wiped away.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: No matter what it's covered in, that doesn't change what's underneath.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Look. It's all clean.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Whenever you're struggling, don't allow your image to define you.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Instead, look at your true self.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: What do you see now?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: When you look at me, what do you see, Abe?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I can't see anything. I'm too starstruck.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: What do you see?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Me.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Cinderella.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: And what kind of person is Cinderella?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: ... Someone who betrayed humanity and killed a lot of people.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: What do you mean? It's not Anachiro who is reflected here.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: It's Cinderella.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: So I'll ask you again. What kind of person is Cinderella?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: A person who, when in despair, received help from the Goddesses and then idolized them.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Someone who wanted to stand on the battlefield alongside them, and applied for that privilege.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Who worked really hard and became a second generation Grimms model.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: A person who took great pride in that truth.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Someone who took thousands, tens of thousands of tests.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Who always strived to achieve the best results.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Who never gave up on her dreams.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Who was always proud and full of confidence.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: A person who loved their comrades.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Someone who loved humanity.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: A person who loved myself.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: The... the most beautiful person...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: in the world.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: And this Cinderella you're describing, what did she want to do?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Defeat those who would harm humanity, and protect the human race.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: To rewrite the story.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: That's better.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Let's do it. Let's rewrite it.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I'll be in the front row watching.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I'll be your mirror.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: I'll watch you become your true self.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: ... Okay.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: You've watched over me all this time.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Even if everyone turned their backs on me, you would remain by my side.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: For you, I will continue my story.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: When you become exhausted and you can't stand to look at yourself.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: When the mirror's surface becomes smudged and dirty.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Just remember my eyes watching you.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: That's where you'll find the most beautiful

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Goddess of Victory this world has ever seen.
